comments.body: MQ-3 RE-SCOPED (Option A, user-approved 2026-06-02) after opus sequencing review. Literal scope (hard-flip I1/I2/I6 + delete check-staged-head.yml + staged-* ruleset + required-checks.txt entry) is SELF-DEADLOCKING before the MQ-6 live cutover: (a) ruleset-design-invariants is a REQUIRED check reading LIVE state (still two-tier) — flipping it reds every promotion; (b) deleting check-staged-head.yml leaves the still-live-required check-staged-head context permanently unreported, wedging MQ-3's own promotion PR. Also contradicts ADR-0019 step-4 atomicity (deletions bundle WITH the live re-provision = MQ-6). DONE: rewrote test-ruleset-design-invariants.sh to TRANSITION-TOLERANT dual-mode (discriminate MQ vs two-tier on a merge_queue rule on MAIN, FAIL-CLOSED to two-tier; two-tier keeps I1-I7, MQ branch asserts M1 merge_queue params + M2 check-staged-head retired + shared I7). Added DSO_RULESET_FIXTURE_DIR offline injection + new meta-test test-ruleset-design-invariants-modes.sh (8/8). Verified live path still passes vs current two-tier (MODE=two_tier; I1/I2/I6 green) — no deadlock. DEFERRED to MQ-6: delete check-staged-head.yml, staged-* ruleset, required-checks.txt entry, and the two-tier assertion branch.
